hypothesis: The implementation of BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.add() incorrectly assumes that any partial can be converted to a valid instant by setting its fields on a zero-based epoch (1970-01-01). When the partial is a MonthDay like --02-29, the call to set() on the dayOfMonth field fails because 1970-02-29 is not a valid date in the ISO chronology. This is an algorithmic flaw in how the partial is processed for addition.
